name: bangladesh-hazards
notes: This spatial dataset provides Hazard data of Bangladesh. Drought risk, Earthquake risk, Flood risk and River erosion risk are included as separated datasets with different attributes.  The source of the data is Bangladesh Agricultural Research Council (BARC). Dataset records are updated by WFP, Map Action and OCHA.

organization.name: ocha-roap
organization.title: OCHA Regional Office for Asia and the Pacific (ROAP)
organization.description: United Nations OCHA Regional Office for Asia and the Pacific (ROAP). Every year, millions of people in Asia and the Pacific region are affected by conflict and natural disasters such as earthquakes, tropical storms, tsunamis, drought, and volcanic eruptions.

title: Bangladesh - Hazards (Drought risk, Earthquake risk, Flood risk and River erosion risk)
